name: hero-media
description: Split-layout hero — text on one side, a media slot (image, illustration, or video poster) on the other. Ships with a default palette-aware SVG illustration so a fresh scaffold renders complete.

ai.whenToUse: Use when the brand benefits from showing a product screenshot, photo, or illustration alongside copy. Best for SaaS with a UI to show, agencies showcasing a project, or any archetype where mood/visual is central. Default illustration is palette-aware so it never feels like a TODO.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use when the message is type-led and copy is the whole point — use `hero-text` instead. Don't use multiple heroes on the same page.

headline.example: The intern your whole team trusts

subheadline.example: Atlas handles your inbox, schedules meetings, and drafts replies — so you get back to building.

mediaSrc.description: Path to the hero media (image, illustration, or video poster). Defaults to the bundled palette-aware illustration at `/illustrations/hero-default.svg`.

mediaAlt.description: Accessibility text for the media. Required if mediaSrc is informational.

mediaPlacement.description: Which side the media sits on. `right` (default) or `left`.
